name: game-mobile-graph
goal: Fit the entire authored checkpoint graph on mobile and retain a selectable key checkpoint

evidence: Native mobile authoring adds a checkpoint then cannot select Collect the key: its node remains outside the graph viewport and normal click scroll cannot reach it.
Extend both existing native mobile authoring scenarios to use Fit View and require the key node fully visible before selection; desktop and tablet remain in the shared matrix.
Immutable f9a734c8 native mobile scenarios fail after Fit View with key-node viewport ratio 0; both dimensions reproduce and captured graph pixels are retained.
Allow the graph viewport and Fit View to zoom down to 0.1 so the full authored dependency chain remains visible on narrow screens.
Paired immutable proof at 586caf35 and 5dbc84de runs the same mobile scenarios, tests, fixture and command: viewport ratio 0 becomes fully visible and both dimensions pass.
